attempts.summary: Deployed a demo app on node2:8080 (systemd service app8080.service) reachable from node3 only via a WireGuard tunnel terminated on node1 (VyOS). node1 runs wg0 (10.200.0.1/24, UDP 51820, peer node3), forwards+masquerades tunnel traffic to node2:8080 via an ipv4 forward-filter default-drop ruleset, and node2's firewalld default-deny zone only accepts port 8080 from node1's LAN IP (10.100.226.10) via a rich rule — so node3 cannot reach node2:8080 directly, only through the tunnel. Verified with curl end-to-end, and confirmed a specific route (10.100.226.11 via wg0) on node3 forces all such traffic through the tunnel. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes, capturing baseline, restart ack, changed boot_id, and post-recovery health/functional proof for each. Along the way fixed a pre-existing app8080.service unit dependency (network-online.target) that would have hung indefinitely on node2 due to an unrelated second NIC (enp8s0) with no DHCP lease.
